name: FinSearchComp
description: FinSearchComp is the first fully open-source benchmark for evaluating realistic, expert-level financial search and reasoning capabilities of LLM-based agents. It includes 635 questions across three tasks that replicate real-world financial analyst workflows, with annotations from 70 professional financial experts and a rigorous quality assurance pipeline.
reputation: A very new benchmark from a recent paper, so it has limited community adoption so far but is notable as the first open-source financial search-and-reasoning benchmark of its kind.
notes: Focuses on realistic financial analyst tasks; includes time-sensitive and complex historical investigation tasks; evaluated on 21 models.
